headline: Germany calls for "transparency" from Deutsche Bank after document leak
summary: Germany has demanded total transparency after a journalistic investigation revealed Deutsche Bank prioritized its business interests over internal risk alerts in certain operations. The report cites dealings with Epstein and Russian oligarchs.
why: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest lender and a major global investment bank, so regulatory scrutiny of its risk controls matters for investors.
original_headline: Alemania pide "transparencia" a Deutsche Bank tras filtración de documentos
